messages:
sasha: Heads-up — planning to enable redwood-open-2.1 as the default on /v1/text-gen tonight at 23:00 PDT. Intend to deprioritize legacy routing so fallback order becomes: redwood-open-2.1 -> redwood-open-2.0 -> gpt-mini. Phased traffic shift: 5% (canary) -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Any blockers? :eyes:
liam: sounds reasonable. two questions — 1) should we pin any enterprise tenants to 2.0 during the ramp? 2) do we have model-variant compatibility notes for streaming? @kevin?
priya: QA found a small tokenization drift on our internal prompt set (~0.6% unexpected outputs). Filed ENG-ML-4321. I'd prefer canary at 5% with a 30m hold and automated evals before increasing.
kevin: +1 to priya. For streaming we validated 2.1 on short sequences but longer context still flaky in 0.2% cases. Suggest pinning top 10 customers who use long-context to 2.0 for the first 24h. I can generate a pinlist.
sasha: OK let's do 5% canary with 30m hold, then 20% with 30m, then 50% with 15m, then final 100%. Pin top-10 long-context customers for 24h. Update the fallback ordering in the catalog before deploy — snippet below.
```json
{
  "route": "text-gen",
  "fallback_order": ["redwood-open-2.1", "redwood-open-2.0", "gpt-mini"],
  "pin_list_s3": "s3://redwood-configs/pinlists/long-context-top10.csv",
  "traffic_steps": ["5%:30m", "20%:30m", "50%:15m", "100%:0m"]
}
```
deploy-bot: Received rollout request: /rollout create --model redwood-open-2.1 --route text-gen --canary 5 --steps 30m,30m,15m --pin-list s3://redwood-configs/pinlists/long-context-top10.csv. Scheduling at 2026-03-20T23:00:00-07:00. Will announce progress here.
priya: I'll trigger the eval suite (regression, toxicity, quality) against the canary traffic and post results in this thread. If any eval shows >1% regression we'll stop and rollback.
liam: rollback plan acked. Command we will run if needed: `rollout rollback --route text-gen --to-model redwood-open-2.0 --pin-file s3://redwood-configs/pinlists/force-pin.csv` — make sure oncall knows the manual step.
qa-bot: Canary started — 5% traffic diverted to redwood-open-2.1. Monitoring dashboards: https://console/reports/rollouts/1872345678. Automated evals queued.
priya: first eval batch (10k prompts) finished: pass. regression 0.4% overall, no safety flags. Posting full CSV to s3://redwood-evals/1872345678/canary-results.csv
kevin: good. I'll hold the pinlist live for 24h. If you want me to unpin earlier ping me here.
sasha: thanks all. proceeding with next 20% step in 30m unless any alerts. I'll draft release notes + short changelog for product and support. Tagging @product for visibility. :rocket:
